blast_radius: Marks tickets as spam/ads; a false positive buries a real customer email.

throughput.derivation: Read-only database query inside the service's own container over one SSH session. count(*) filter (where flagged_spam) by day(synced_at) over a trailing window; 24h = synced_at >= now()-24h.
notes: Lifetime deflection rate is high (illustrative: roughly 13,000 of 19,000 tickets, ~68%).
A small, explicitly blocklisted set of sender domains accounts for a portion of flagged mail.
throughput.signal_path: postgres://example-service-db/example_service (container-local; credentials in EXAMPLE_SERVICE_* env, never read by capmap)#tickets.flagged_spam

verification.note: Graded on throughput, not liveness: a running loop with zero volume is DEGRADED.
verification.source: postgres://example-service-db/example_service (container-local; credentials in EXAMPLE_SERVICE_* env, never read by capmap)#tickets.flagged_spam

what_it_does: Spam/advertisement deflection classifier for the support pipeline. Volume is tickets flagged as automated or promotional mail in the window.
why_it_matters: Deflection keeps a large share of ingested mail out of the human support queue; a stall here means spam and ad mail starts reaching agents directly.
